chunks: 2570 - ʿAmr ibn Shumr narrated from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“They only deemed the marking of the sacrificial camels commendable because with the first drop that falls from its blood, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, forgives him for that.”

key_terms.أَوَّلَ قَطْرَةٍ: the first drop of blood that falls at slaughter
key_terms.إِشْعَارَ: marking the sacrificial animal as designated for offering
key_terms.الْبُدْنِ: the sacrificial camels offered in hajj
key_terms.دَمِهَا: the blood of the sacrificial animal

ai.seo_question: Why is marking sacrificial animals considered commendable in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the merit behind the practice of marking sacrificial camels in the rites of hajj. It indicates that this act was regarded as commendable because Allah عز وجل grants forgiveness to the offerer with the first drop of the animal’s blood.
